sources.quote: cracks around fastening holes on brackets machined from EN AW-6082 material delivered by the supplier; found at incoming inspection on BR-310.
The 8D on the 6082 cracks is not closed yet, corrective action still being verified.

findings.why: Meccanica Chisone (SUP-C) has an open 8D on EN AW-6082 material, found on BR-310, which is made of 6082-T5. The 8D is still open as of 2026-11-06, even though the company was re-qualified. The packaging change itself (40 per layer) is already covered by DEV-125, valid 2026-08-01 to 2027-01-31, and needs no other finding.
